title: HQ's member count for a gym includes members the gym has archived
what: HQ's gym list, gym page and branch list show 'members in the register'. That number counts every member record that is not deleted, archived members included. The gym's own admin app leaves archived members out of its lists and counts. A gym that archives people who left sees a bigger number in HQ than on its own screens, and HQ sorts gyms by this bigger number.
expected: HQ counts members the same way the gym's own screens do: archived members left out, or shown as a separate number.
fix_line: Leave archived members out of HQ's member count, or show them as their own number

title: The server still keeps an old free-plan rule that limits routines to 4, while the app now says routines are free
what: The server keeps a switched-off free-plan setting: 4 routines, 7 own exercises, 3 months of charts. The member app stopped reading it on 12 Nov; its rules now live in the app, and routines are free for everyone there. The server setting and the app's call that reads it are still there. Anyone who turns the server switch on, or reads it as the current rule, gets a limit the product no longer has.
expected: One place holds the free-plan rules. The old server setting and the unused app call are removed, or marked as retired.
how_often: only if someone reads or switches the old rule
fix_line: Remove the old free-plan setting and the unused call, or mark them retired

title: A workout-offer day stays counted after the gym takes back the check-in that proved it
what: A day counts toward a workout offer only when the gym's register has a check-in for that member on that day. The count is taken when the phone sends its days. If the desk later takes back that check-in, for example a wrong member checked in, the counted day stays. It can still lead to an earned reward and free days on the plan.
expected: Taking back a check-in also takes back the offer day it proved, unless the reward was already given.
who: gym owners running a workout offer
how_often: rare: only when a check-in is taken back
fix_line: When a check-in is taken back, remove the offer day it proved if no reward was given yet
